author: Today I Found Out
description:
Hermann Göring was second only to Hitler in the hierarchy of the Third Reich. Commander of the Luftwaffe, acting Prime Minister of Prussia, President of the Reichstag, and Hitler’s designated successor – Göring’s Nazi resume was almost unparalleled, as were the atrocities he took part in. His brother, Albert, however, could not have been more the opposite- an unsung forgotten hero of the war, saving countless lives through his work to undermine his brother and Hitler. This is the story of Hermann and Albert Göring.

Host: Simon Whistler
Producer: Samuel Avila
Editor: Daven Hiskey

title: A Tale of Two Brothers- The Devil and the Absolute Legend
